title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF advanced immunization in Bosnia and Herzegovina through pneumococcal vaccine introduction plans, cold chain upgrades, IT system strengthening, and EVM SOP development with health institutions in FBiH and RS. These efforts ensure optimal vaccine handling, minimize adverse events, and enable real-time monitoring, improving equitable health protection for children.
